summary.headline: Mercury–Venus Conjunction in Water Signs
summary.text: Astrological predictions for the conjunction of Mercury and Venus in the watery triplicity, Cancer, Scorpio, and Pisces, including effects on rainfall, crops, travel, commerce, rulers, warfare, earthquakes, and social conditions. The text then begins discussing the conjunction of the Moon and Venus in the four triplicities.
